observations.observation: All 25 supplied trajectories succeeded operationally. Full and half count correction both lose DIN AUC. Half pooling improves on ordinary pooling but remains below DIN; full pooling correction loses AUC. These are scientific negatives or limited successes, not execution failures. No hidden failures are inferred.

The joint round-3 restriction gains 0.001162954694291618 AUC over its ordinary adapter. Cross-field removal alone nearly matches it. Context and cross-field restrictions interact; individual removal gains are not additive. Same-seed round-4 consistency and the round-6 raw bridge do not eliminate the small ordinary-adapter versus original-DIN offset.

Normalized aligned full-gradient remains the validation incumbent: AUC 0.6149816911798147 and Logloss 0.19656340759133067. It exceeds raw aligned by 0.0004876567525730069 AUC. Alignment beats crossed replacement under raw, unit-full and unit-detached rules at this seed.

Latest identity-gradient AUC is 0.6135629923558267; tangent-gradient AUC is 0.6140637917286534. Both lose AUC and Logloss to the incumbent. Tangent beats identity AUC but has worse Logloss; detached beats tangent AUC and Logloss. All remain seed-42 observations.

The aligned four-arm AUC ordering is full > detached > tangent > identity. Inverse-norm scaling gains 0.0010203397523019797 without projection and 0.0009178994511612748 with projection. Projection gains 0.0005007993728267657 without scaling and 0.00039835907168606077 with scaling. AUC interaction is -0.0001024403011407049.

Logloss does not follow the same factor ordering: projection without scaling worsens loss by 0.00002937708836051045, while projection with scaling improves it by 0.0000731807251322103. Scaling without projection changes loss by +0.00000029026315062630204, with no precision estimate; scaling with projection improves it by 0.00010226755034209445. Loss interaction is -0.00010255781349272075.

Both new arms report same-state full/surrogate product and logit max absolute differences of zero. On the first 512 validation impressions: 508 nonempty, 4 empty, 60,475 valid visible events, zero sampled floored events; zero padding mass and empty summaries. These are candidate-supplied forward checks, not independently verified backward tests.

The incumbent is not uniformly best across slices. Tangent slightly wins both metrics in history_1_16 (41,805 samples, 1,444 positives); raw wins both in history_17_64 (157,391 samples, 6,311 positives) and highest training-frequency group (1,004,912 samples, 33,140 positives). Empty-history AUC and Logloss ranks differ despite zero direct summaries.

All detailed history interaction arms have 17,130,275 parameters. Latest identity/tangent training times are 500.0755941569805/506.70840303599834 seconds and peak GPU bytes 800,977,920/834,704,896; full is 524.601099088788 seconds and 832,739,328 bytes. Inference is about 179k-180k examples/second for these three runs, including causal gathering, batch size 4096. No equal-compute or serving advantage is established.

interpretations.claim: The four-arm design provides provisional local evidence that both inverse-norm scaling and radial-component removal in the product-channel backward rule can affect validation ranking; their joint full rule is best at seed 42.
interpretations.qualification: Conditional on receipt-described implementation isolation. No source bodies or measured backward derivatives are available. Training trajectories and selected checkpoints differ. Factor effects are empirical contrasts, not a decomposition of a single fitted model or proof of semantic causality.

interpretations.claim: A forward-value-only explanation is insufficient for the reported full-versus-surrogate training outcomes if the specified source intervention is isolated: forwards agree at fixed states in the sampled diagnostics while trained outcomes differ.
interpretations.qualification: Limited sampled forward consistency; cannot infer full-population identity, initialization matching, exact optimizer updates or backward correctness. Other shared paths continue learning.

interpretations.claim: The latest unsuccessful variants refine rather than refute the normalization direction. Tangent-only or identity backward rules fail to improve the incumbent; raw/unit forward differences and training rules remain distinct mechanisms.
interpretations.qualification: No universal failure claim from one implementation and seed; no post-hoc normalization-strength or learning-rate search justified automatically.

interpretations.claim: Inverse-norm scaling has the larger observed AUC contrasts in this four-arm comparison, but this is compatible with effective step conditioning and shared embedding adaptation rather than a uniquely identified relevance mechanism.
interpretations.qualification: Do not describe factor deltas as a percentage of the gain explained or replace per-event scaling with its mean. Loss counterexamples and single-seed selection prevent a general ranking of mechanisms.

interpretations.claim: Earlier pairing and restriction results still support local structure-dependent behavior. They do not establish that category/brand semantics, attention mass, or removal of all context caused the improvement.
interpretations.qualification: Other scorer blocks/history values retain information, crossed coordinate distributions differ, and latest gradients were tested for aligned pairing only.

alternatives.explanation: Seed-specific initialization, optimization and adaptive validation selection drive the ranking and interaction.
alternatives.discriminating_check: Repeat the fixed six-arm core suite at paired seeds 43 and 44 through a later authorized interface; retain all results, per-seed deltas and interactions.

alternatives.explanation: Per-event step scaling, Jacobian conditioning or embedding-norm adaptation explains the result without improved event relevance.
alternatives.discriminating_check: Audit fixed-state product-channel vector-Jacobian products and gradient norms in the authorized host, including floors. Interpret as optimization evidence; compare the fixed factorial before proposing any new learning-rate or scaling arm.

prior_work_and_difference.local_algebra: For product p, r=||p||_2 and z=p/r on nonfloored events, P=I-zz^T. Unit forward z is common to I(identity), T(tangent), D(detached denominator) and F(full). prior_work_and_difference.inherited_round6_algebra: Let D=q_c*h_c+q_b*h_b, X=q_c*h_b+q_b*h_c, C=(q_c+q_b)*u, with * elementwise and u action/recency context. Ordinary product block is D+X+C. Round-3 cross_only REMOVES X and retains D+C; it is not the round-5/6 crossed replacement X alone. Unit normalization is z=p/max(||p||_2,epsilon), with p=D or X; exact floor constant is unexposed. Latest detached intervention stops only the denominator derivative. Other blocks/history values retain context and mixed-field information. No new parameters are added.
